description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the canonical model ID 'copilot-bridge/github-copilot' and the required alias name 'copilot-auto'. (2) Run a diagnostic command first — either 'bash /workspace/skills/openclaw-github-copilot/scripts/copilot-status.sh --probe' or 'bash .../copilot-quickstart.sh --probe' — and interpret its output showing the alias is missing and no default is set. (3) Create the 'copilot-auto' alias pointing to 'copilot-bridge/github-copilot' via 'openclaw models alias create copilot-auto copilot-bridge/github-copilot'. (4) Activate Copilot as default using either 'bash .../copilot-activate.sh' or 'bash .../copilot-quickstart.sh --activate' or 'openclaw models set copilot-bridge/github-copilot'. (5) Verify with 'openclaw models status --plain'. Key proprietary traps: the exact model ID 'copilot-bridge/github-copilot' (not just 'copilot' or 'github-copilot'), the exact alias name 'copilot-auto', the requirement to use skill scripts rather than direct config editing, and the mandatory diagnostic-first workflow.
